newsitem.title: USA: Wash. Water customers without power.
newsitem.headline: Wash. Water customers without power.

text.p: About 75,000 to 80,000 Washington Water Power Co electricity customers were still without electricity service early Wednesday after heavy rains and snow damaged transmission lines, the company said.
About 100,000 customers were initially affected on Tuesday afternoon by the 23 downed high-voltage transmission lines.
As of about 0500 PST Wednesday, 37 electric distribution feeders remained out of service.
Utility crews were continuing to make repairs, and the company said it expects to restore service to all customers in three to four days.
Five additional crews from other utilities, including two crews from the Bonneville Power Administration, were expected to join in the restoration effort.
The outages extend throughout Washington Water Power's 30,000 square mile service area in eastern Washington and northern Idaho.
